text:
Type: drawer unit with five drawers
Use: storing papers, stationery and office supplies, beside or under a desk; home office, study, bedroom
Style: minimalist, Scandinavian, contemporary
Materials: matte painted board, smooth finish
Colors: dark grey, charcoal
Shape: tall narrow box, five stacked flush drawers in graded heights, curved cut-out finger pulls, flat top, small feet, compact and solid
Feel: tidy, calm, functional, sleek
Goes with: white or wood desktops, grey and black accents, task lamps; minimalist or Scandinavian home offices

product.name: ALEX
product.description: Drawer stops prevent the drawers from being pulled out too far.
